findings.claim: The covers list (lines 9-11 and 42-44) places the box being built up at 0:00-3:49 and "Margin between boxes, including vertical margins that collapse into one" at 3:49-6:10. YouTube's live key moments for this video instead mark Border at 2:06, Margin at 2:26, Padding at 3:40 and Border Box at 6:12, so 3:49-6:10 is the padding section, not margin. Live caption tracks could not be fetched to confirm that margin collapsing is taught anywhere in the video, so both the 3:49-6:10 description and the o3 gap ("margin collapsing is mentioned briefly") are unverified while the timing as written contradicts the platform data.
